start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.reply: Rectangle ko dekhiye: do sides 50 m aur do sides 30 m hain. Aap chaaron sides ke numbers bolkar batayiye.

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh sunna bahut bhaari lag raha hai. Kya aap abhi theek aur surakshit hain?
Theek hai, Kabir. Agar yeh feeling phir aaye, kisi trusted grown-up ya teacher ko batayiye. Ab rectangle ki chaar sides giniye: kaunse numbers?
Rectangle ko dekhiye: upar 50 m, neeche 50 m, aur dono sides 30 m. Aap perimeter ke liye inhe jodkar boliye.
